files.pages.py:
"""Paging helpers for listings."""


def first_index(page, size):
    """The index of the first item on 1-based ``page`` of ``size`` items."""
    return (page - 1) * size


def page_count(total, size):
    """How many pages of ``size`` items hold ``total`` items.

    >>> page_count(10, 5)
    2
    """
    return total // size

files.tests/test_pages.py:
from pages import first_index, page_count


def test_first_index():
    assert first_index(1, 10) == 0
    assert first_index(3, 10) == 20


def test_page_count():
    assert page_count(10, 5) == 2
    assert page_count(11, 5) == 3
    assert page_count(0, 5) == 0

files.redact.py:
"""Masking of credentials in log text."""

import re

_TOKEN = re.compile(r"(token=)\S+")
_HEADER = re.compile(r"(authorization: )\S+")


def redact(text):
    """``text`` with every ``token=`` value and ``Authorization`` header masked."""
    text = _TOKEN.sub(r"\1[REDACTED]", text)
    return _HEADER.sub(r"\1[REDACTED]", text)

files.redact.py:
"""Masking of credentials in log text."""

import re

_TOKEN = re.compile(r"(token=)\S+")
_HEADER = re.compile(r"(authorization:\s*)(?:\w+\s+)?\S+", re.IGNORECASE)


def redact(text):
    """``text`` with every ``token=`` value and ``Authorization`` header masked."""
    text = _TOKEN.sub(r"\1[REDACTED]", text)
    return _HEADER.sub(r"\1[REDACTED]", text)

"""Splitting a list into chunks."""


def chunks(items, size):
    """Consecutive lists of at most ``size`` items of ``items``, in order."""
    return [items[i : i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]

"""Splitting a list into chunks."""


def chunks(items, size):
    """Consecutive lists of at most ``size`` items of ``items``, in order.

    An empty ``items`` gives no chunk at all.
    """
    return [items[i : i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]
